description: READ-ONLY: query DeFi protocols, yield/lending/liquid-staking/LP/RWA markets, or wallet positions across all 10 Binance Web3 DeFi chains (BNB 56, Ethereum 1, Base 8453, Arbitrum 42161, Arc 5042, Polygon 137, Optimism 10, Avalanche 43114, Robinhood 4663, Katana 747474). Returns APY, base/reward APY breakdown, TVL, redeemDelayDays, yieldAnalytics, and investmentId with a fetch timestamp. Use propose_defi when the user wants an action card.

address.description: Optional 0x EVM wallet address for scope=positions (auto-resolved from user's connected wallets when omitted).

chain.description: Optional chain filter by slug or chainId: bnb (56), ethereum (1), base (8453), arbitrum (42161), arc (5042), polygon (137), optimism (10), avalanche (43114), robinhood (4663), katana (747474).

investment_id.description: Investment pool ID for scope=investment_detail (e.g. bn-aave4-5042-usdc).

protocol.description: Optional defiProtocolId filter (e.g. aave3, aave4, uniswap3, uniswap4, pancakeswap3, pancakeswap4, morphoblue, venus, venusflux, helio, astherus, lido, pendle2, spark, solv, renzo, rocketpool, quickswap3, benqi, frax, maple, cian, emberso, rexyz, usdai).

scope.description: What to read: investments (default, yield/lending/LP markets), protocols (21+ audited platforms), positions (wallet-scoped DeFi holdings & rewards), protocol_detail (single protocol + markets), or investment_detail (single pool by investment_id).

token.description: Optional underlying token symbol or contract address filter (e.g. USDC, USDT, BNB, ETH, sUSDe).

name: read_defi
title: Read Binance Web3 DeFi data
